concerns.text: T016 (Write output results to p_values_raw.csv) and T018 (Save aggregated error rates) are marked as incomplete/missing, yet T020 (Threshold Finder) and T031 (Real Data Validation) explicitly depend on these artifacts. The consumer tasks (T020, T031) are listed before the producer tasks (T016, T018) are marked complete, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' dependency rule.

T032 (Bootstrapped power estimation) and T034 (Save validation metrics) are marked as incomplete/failed. T033 (Generate validation report) depends on the output of T032/T034 to state whether simulation held true. The report generation task (consumer) is listed before the data generation tasks (producers) are marked complete, breaking the data-flow dependency.

T012b (Refactor test_runner for dynamic alpha) is listed AFTER T012 (Implement test_runner). T012's description explicitly states it 'supports dynamic alpha (FR-002, FR-007)', implying it requires the refactored logic from T012b to function as described. T012b must precede T012 to ensure the implementation task actually implements the required feature.

T015a (Implement vectorized operations) is listed after T012 (Implement test_runner). T012's description mentions handling [deferred] iterations efficiently. If T012 is implemented without the vectorization from T015a, it may fail the performance constraint (6h runtime). T015a (the optimization) should precede or be merged with T012 to ensure the implementation is performant from the start.

T013 and T013b are listed after T012, but T012's description includes 'The system must detect expected cell counts less than 5 and route to fallback logic'. T013 implements this fallback logic. T013 should precede T012 so that T012 can correctly call the implemented fallback logic.
